name: UnfairPlay IPA Loader
description: Open and decrypt personalized iOS IPAs through Plugins > UnfairPlay > Open IPA and the UnfairPlay CLI.
longdescription: A global Open IPA menu command selects the UnfairPlay container transform explicitly, offers CLI decryption with saved enrollment models, and opens the selected executable through the native Mach-O loader. The container transform also supports API sessions. Install unfairplay_ipa.py beside __init__.py as documented in README.md. No FairPlay key recovery runs in Python.
